name: RadioButtonGroup

props.name: decorator
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a decorator component to be rendered inside the `RadioButtonGroup` component

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Specify the `<RadioButton>` to be selected by default

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify whether the group is disabled

props.name: helperText
props.description: Provide text that is used alongside the control label for additional help

props.name: invalid
props.description: Specify whether the control is currently invalid

props.name: invalidText
props.description: Provide the text that is displayed when the control is in an invalid state

props.name: labelPosition
props.description: Provide where label text should be placed

props.name: legendText
props.description: Provide a legend to the RadioButtonGroup input that you are exposing to the user

props.name: name
props.description: Specify the name of the underlying `<input>` nodes

props.name: orientation
props.description: Provide where radio buttons should be placed

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the RadioButtonGroup should be read-only

props.name: required
props.description: `true` to specify if input selection in group is required.

props.name: slug
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `Slug` component to be rendered inside the `RadioButtonGroup` component

props.name: valueSelected
props.description: Specify the value that is currently selected in the group

props.name: warn
props.description: Specify whether the control is currently in warning state

props.name: warnText
props.description: Provide the text that is displayed when the control is in warning state

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon RadioButtonGroup rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
